answer: Require every agent to BURN a small fixed coin amount per action rather than merely lock it: each submission leaves an irreversible on-ledger receipt, as permanent as oxidized ferrous metal and as hard to fake as a flawless crystal. Being non-refundable, the burn never compounds like stake, so a Sybil operator running 1,000 clones must pay it 1,000 separate times with zero recovery on any horizon. Duplication meets a hard per-identity cost floor instead of amortizing one deposit across the whole farm.
